one_liner: Nifty 50 surges 1.60% driven by a strong IT sector rally.

drivers.title: Nifty IT Surge
drivers.detail: Nifty IT index jumped 5.22%, no specific catalyst identified.

drivers.title: Volatility Drops
drivers.detail: India VIX fell by 7.43%, indicating reduced market volatility.

drivers.title: DII Buying
drivers.detail: DIIs were net buyers with Rs 2,439.24 Cr inflow.

flows_line: FIIs sold Rs 1,305.13 Cr while DIIs bought Rs 2,439.24 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for ECB and BOE speeches and US CPI data tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: Nifty IT's unexplained surge highlights sector volatility.
DII buying supports market despite FII selling.
Reduced volatility may encourage risk-on sentiment.
Positive breadth indicates broad market strength.
